claimBoundary: Adam's rulings remain authoritative. Implementation responses document repaired prototype tools and new proof candidates; they do not convert a technical PASS into art admission or make any current sprite final.

rulings.finding: The real infinite-repeat output is broken. A one-pixel edge equality gate is not periodic course closure.
rulings.requiredNext: Use rectangular period-closed dimensions; require width mod xStep = 0, height mod yStep = 0, and an even course-row count for stagger parity. Remove forcePeriodic as a seam-laundering fallback.

rulings.finding: Camera equivalence is unproved and the chosen leaf sources are already clipped at image boundaries.
rulings.requiredNext: Reject edge-clipped leaf art before staging, declare the production 35-degree elevation, 45-degree bearing, 20-degree FOV and rotation policy, and prove the card through the real dressing renderer with standee-wins-ground depth behavior.

rulings.finding: The current aged state is too conservative.
rulings.requiredNext: Generate a stronger age ladder in the canonical material workbench, then use Assetforge only to register and verify the selected states.

rulings.finding: Assetforge now wraps the canonical Lab/CIEDE2000 pipeline and shared defringe instead of owning a nearest-RGB variant. The real candidate preserves alpha and semantic colors, reports mean CIEDE2000 4.1830 and p95 8.2468, shifts dominant hue 3.6507 degrees, preserves value rank at 0.9549, and contains zero forbidden-chroma pixels.
rulings.requiredNext: Keep build/unify-corpus.py as the only palette algorithm authority. Treat future Assetforge work as manifest, quarantine, proof, and receipt orchestration.

rulings.finding: Useful for offline/world/canvas sprite elongation even where CSS border-image or nine-slice layout can serve DOM UI.

Assetforge is now a single-asset adapter over the canonical registry contract and preserves the source canvas. The production renderer v2 adds trilinear mipmapped minification, alpha-to-coverage, a 0.12 readability floor, and reduced realm-tint contamination. A hash-bound four-lighting A/B proves the renderer contract on seven real registry sprites; no sprite art is admitted.
rulings.requiredNext: Retain the one canonical schema and renderer. Adam reviews the low-light A/B as a prototype renderer candidate; individual sprite taste and production admission remain separate.

rulings.finding: The compiler now retains Blob47 architectural enclosure and adds an eight-way 256-shape wilderness path dialect, a cardinal 16-shape road dialect with shoulders and ruts, and a cardinal transition plus integer-elevation cliff dialect. Each dialect has four individual real-material renders; the combined board is navigation only.
rulings.requiredNext: Adam reviews the individual path, road, and cliff boards. Technical coverage does not approve their visual language or runtime routing.
